help.title: Help articles
help.intro: Quick answers to the most common questions. Still stuck? Use Contact support at the top of the page.

line.title: Set up a line
body: Open Queues and choose Add a queue, then name it for what guests wait for, such as Walk-ins.
Pick the services it offers and how long each usually takes. Wait estimates come from these.
Set the opening hours in Opening hours. Outside them the line shows as closed and guests can't join.
Switch the queue on when you are ready. Guests can join as soon as it is open.
You can pause a line any time from Today without losing the people already waiting.

callNext.title: Call the next guest
body: Open Today or the staff console and press Call next. The guest who has waited longest is called.
The guest sees their turn on their phone, and gets a message if they allowed one.
When they arrive, press Start. When you finish, press Done.
If they don't show up, mark them as a no-show so the line moves on.
Pressed the wrong thing? Use Undo straight after.

qr.title: Share the QR code
body: Open QR poster to see the code that opens your join page.
Print the poster and put it where guests will see it: the door, the counter or the window.
Guests can scan it from any phone, and the printed code keeps working.
You can also copy the join link and send it in a message or add it to your website.
Guests don't need an account or an app. They scan, enter a first name and join.

sms.title: Text messages (SMS)
body: Guests only get texts when they gave a phone number and agreed to be messaged.
Edit the wording of each message in Messages. Keep it short and say who it is from.
Texts need an SMS provider connected under Connections. Without one, guests see their place on the page instead.
If a guest replies STOP they get no more texts from you.
Failed messages are listed under Message activity so you can follow up by phone.

staff.title: Add staff and set roles
body: Open Team and invite people by email. They get a link that lets them set a password.
Owners can change everything. Admins manage lines and people. Staff run the queue.
Pick the role when you invite someone. You can change it later from the same page.
Remove someone when they leave. They lose access straight away.
Open Roles to see exactly what each role can do.

hours.title: Opening hours
body: Open Opening hours to set when each day starts and ends.
Times use your location's time zone, so check it under Location first.
You can add a closed day or special hours for a holiday.
Outside opening hours guests see that you're closed and can't join the line.
Staying open late? Pause the line from Today instead of changing your hours.

data.title: Delete guest or account data
body: To erase one guest, open Data requests under Privacy and find them by the exact phone number or email they gave.
You can download everything held about them first, then press Erase.
Use Export data if you want a copy of your own records.
To close the whole account, owners can use the Danger zone. Everything is erased after 7 days, and until then you can call it off.
Questions about privacy? Use Contact support and we will help.
